probes.name: Control
probes.source_text:
import MulticlassVectorCapacity.EdgeCases
open MulticlassVectorCapacity

example : benefit ThreeClass.model (ThreeClass.labels 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) 0 = 3 / 5 := by
  rw [ThreeClass.labels_benefit]
  norm_num

example : fiberDecision EdgeCases.zeroCostModel ThreeClass.observable ThreeClass.observedValue 0 =
    some .abstain := EdgeCases.zero_cost_boundary_abstains

example : ¬ ∃ η : ConditionalLabels (Fin 1) (Fin 3), η.prob 0 1 = -1 / 5 :=
  EdgeCases.negative_conditional_coordinate_rejected

example : ¬ ∃ η : ConditionalLabels (Fin 1) (Fin 3), ∀ y, η.prob 0 y = 1 :=
  EdgeCases.unnormalized_simplex_rejected

probes.name: NegativeSimplexCoordinate
probes.source_text:
import MulticlassVectorCapacity.EdgeCases
open MulticlassVectorCapacity

noncomputable def invalidLabels : ConditionalLabels (Fin 1) (Fin 3) where
  prob := fun _ => ![1 / 5, -1 / 5, 1]
  nonneg := by intro _ y; fin_cases y <;> norm_num
  sum_one := by intro _; norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

probes.name: WrongObservableFiber
probes.source_text:
import MulticlassVectorCapacity.EdgeCases
open MulticlassVectorCapacity

noncomputable def validLabelsWrongMoment : ConditionalLabels (Fin 1) (Fin 3) where
  prob := fun _ => ![2 / 5, 3 / 5, 0]
  nonneg := by intro _ y; fin_cases y <;> norm_num
  sum_one := by intro _; norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

example : validLabelsWrongMoment ∈ fiber ThreeClass.observable ThreeClass.observedValue := by
  apply (ThreeClass.mem_fiber_iff _).mpr
  norm_num [validLabelsWrongMoment]
